eli_s: Quick Q from ACME POC — they require BYOK with HSM-backed keys and quarterly rotation. Can we support a POC that uses their Azure Key Vault (HSM) or an AWS CloudHSM? Any blockers on our side?

maria_se: Short answer: yes. We support customer-managed keys for Private and Dedicated deployments. We store only key references (URIs) and use the customer's KMS/HSM for key material. In-transit TLS + encryption-at-rest remains enforced.

sam_security: From Sec/Risk: we'll need SIG/CAIQ entries filled for KM controls, evidence of key rotation procedures, KMS access policies, audit log retention. Also confirm HSM attestation availability.

maria_se: POC playbook (high level):
1) Customer provides KMS key URI + service principal with limited read/use permissions
2) We stand up a short-lived Dedicated or Private deployment and configure the KMS reference
3) Customer performs key import/creation in their HSM (BYOK flow) or we reference an existing HSM-backed key
4) Run validation: 1) verify no key material in our control plane 2) test tokenized traffic + replay protection 3) validate audit logs for key use
Estimated calendar: 10–18 business days depending on legal + network setup.

maria_se: Example config snippet for Private (illustrative):
```
key_management:
  provider: azure_kv
  key_uri: "azure-kv://subscriptions/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/resourceGroups/rg/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/acme-vault/keys/acme-key"
  credential: "client-id:xxxxxxxx, client-secret:••••••"
  hsm_backed: true
```
Rotation notes: create a new key version in the customer's AKV/AWS KMS and either point to the explicit version or use a stable name that resolves to the new version. Our workers cache key references; a rolling restart or config reload promotes the new key. We emit key-use and rotation events to audit logs (/var/log/redwood/kms-usage.log).

anne_ae: Customer asked about attestation: can we provide HSM attestation or a proof-of-origin statement (MAA/attestation doc)?

sam_security: Yes — for Azure AKV HSM we can reference Microsoft MAA docs and tie that to our SIG response. For AWS CloudHSM/Nitro we can provide the relevant attestation links and a short statement about our integration boundaries. I'll attach the SIG/CAIQ snippet and attestation pointers to the deal folder. :thumbsup:

eli_s: Does BYOK with HSM add any extra product fees?

leo_finance: BYOK as a feature has no separate per-key fee from our side, but Dedicated/Private + any reserved capacity for HSM-backed throughput is priced higher. Ballpark: add-on infra delta + one-time integration engineering fee. I'll put a ballpark in the spreadsheet and DM the AE.

maria_se: For the POC we can do a time-limited Dedicated instance with reduced capacity to demonstrate rotation + audit. If customer needs longer retention for logs we can enable extended retention as an add-on.

eli_s: Great. Action items: Sam to upload SIG/CAIQ + attestation docs; Leo to share pricing ballpark; Maria to send POC checklist + timeline; I'll update ACME. Thanks everyone :100:
